blocks.text: Easekey keeps the idea of releasing a held tension in a key, wheel and coil. Its name describes an everyday hope; its effects still have to be read rather than assumed.
A turning key with a wound ribbon. Release the coil.
One-shot use: The key releases its long violet ribbons, extends its applicator, and ejects the front piece, leaving an empty opening. The game performs the final fade.

13 silver. Injury / Chronic severity −1; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Health +3; Happiness +8. Health +4 more if Chronic remains after treatment. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
